findings.problem: Artifact ID and digest are not required or shape-validated until the success receipt after all five children. Empty artifact-ids is passed directly to download-artifact, allowing its unselected default behavior; late env indexing can fail after compilation.
findings.requested: Require nonempty decimal artifact ID and exact 64-hex digest before download and before imports/children; test absent, empty and malformed identities.

findings.problem: The downloaded snapshot receipt is loaded once but excluded from preflight/postflight identities. The artifact root is not a closed namespace, and the claimed generated tree digest is copied without independently recomputing the SourceDigest record format.
findings.requested: Bind the ordinary downloaded receipt identity into each flight, close the entire transferred artifact, and recompute its complete generated-tree digest.

findings.problem: RLIMIT_CPU(420) does not enforce the stated collector active wall deadline. Final retained artifact enumeration/hash has no implemented 60-second budget or whole-output node/total-byte limit.
findings.requested: Implement collector/retention wall deadlines with a reserved per-command custody/cleanup margin, bounded regular-node discovery and total output limits, and guarded data controls.

findings.problem: rglob completes unbounded discovery before checking node/byte limits; class and final artifact discovery can follow symlink file targets and ignore nonregular nodes. Generated discovery is also unbounded.
findings.requested: Bound discovery while traversing, reject symlinks/nonordinary nodes, enforce per-file and aggregate budgets before hashing and before upload, cover negative fixtures.

findings.problem: The eleven prepared controls cover only parsing and floor-reader data. No source-binding, artifact identity/path/topology, receipt mutation, output budget or deadline controls are prepared. tempfile cleanup is incompatible with the root-selected exact deny_runtime write/deletion policy.
findings.requested: Add targeted controls for integration invariants under the selected known-source guard policy; keep execution pending until authorized.
